positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the frontend using Angular, ensuring a responsive and user-friendly interface for desktop. 
• Utilized the .NET framework to build custom APIs that facilitated seamless data synchronization between the Angular frontend and Dynamics CRM backend.
 • Designed and implemented efficient GraphQL services using Spring Boot, enabling optimized data retrieval, and reducing over-fetching of information.
 • Collaborated closely with the front-end team to conceptualize and construct React applications that seamlessly integrate with GraphQL services, ensuring optimal performance and user experience.
 • Implemented reusable UI components and design systems to ensure consistency across different applications.
 • Actively participated in code reviews, providing valuable insights and suggestions to enhance code quality and maintainability.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Backend developer, who played a pivotal role in the development and maintenance of a sophisticated fee schedule application using the .NET framework. Collaborating closely with a cross-functional team, I contributed to the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptualization to deployment and ongoing enhancements.
Responsibilities: 
• Maintains on Fee Schedule database using SQL Server Management Studio 2008
• Keep Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, OPTUM and state specific data up to date.
• Create and enhance: tables, indexes, views and store procedures.
• Developed Fee Schedule using visual studio 2008 (C sharp Asp.net) and SQL Server Management Studio 2008

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description:

* Helped students create and follow study schedules to achieve their goal.

projects.title: Connected Patients
projects.description:
•	Capstone (senior) project Connected Patients: Worked in a group where we research how wearable devices like fit-bit keep track of user’s health. We then developed an android application to be a hub that is capable of connecting to multiple health devices through Bluetooth. Our application send patients health information to a cloud database at real time. 
o	Used Parse database.
o	Created a doctor app to view patient’s progress.
